title: thelypteris andina
intro: Thelypteris andina, commonly known as the Andean maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in South America, where it is valued for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris andina include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have potential in preventing oxidative stress and inflammation.
